class.name: WorldsMeshTopology
class.brief_description: Optional CPU validation of indexed triangle topology and shared geometric borders.
class.description: WorldsMeshTopology inspects indices, coincident 3D positions, and ordered boundary samples without modifying the mesh. Exact-position welding can distinguish duplicated UV/material vertices from genuine open index edges, but does not weld approximately coincident vertices. None of the results certify watertight rasterization, self-intersection freedom or compatible materials. Compile with module_worlds_geometry_enabled=yes to use this experimental class.

method.name: analyze_indexed_surface
method.description: Counts invalid triangles, duplicate faces, zero-area triangles, open edges, nonmanifold edges, and winding conflicts by index identity. Returns a Dictionary containing [code]valid_input[/code], [code]closed_oriented_2manifold[/code] and per-category counts.

method.name: analyze_position_surface
method.description: Returns [code]indexed[/code] and [code]welded[/code] topology Dictionaries, plus [code]unique_positions[/code], [code]coincident_vertex_duplicates[/code] and [code]indexed_open_edges_resolved[/code]. Welding uses exact XYZ equality, not a distance tolerance. Position-based adjacency is diagnostic and does not change mesh vertices.

method.name: compare_border_samples
method.description: Compares two ordered 3D boundary polylines. Requires the same number of nondegenerate samples, with reversed vertex order. Any missing split vertex is flagged as a possible T-junction. A nonnegative [param tolerance] permits coordinate gaps up to that distance; this cannot certify fully crack-free triangles. Returns [code]valid_input[/code], [code]geometry_match[/code], [code]opposite_direction[/code], [code]same_direction[/code], [code]t_junction_risk[/code], [code]samples_a[/code], [code]samples_b[/code] and [code]max_opposing_gap[/code].
